exposure: Antenatal care model (private obstetrician-gynecologists versus national health system providers)
more than four antenatal ultrasound examinations
Women with more than four antenatal ultrasound examinations
national health system providers (certified nurse midwifes supervised by obstetrician-gynecologists)
cohort: 2,831 women with singleton, term, live births
finding: While obstetric and neonatal outcomes were not dependent on obstetric providers, multiple prenatal ultrasound examinations in low-risk obstetric populations appear to be an independent risk factor for cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Multiple prenatal ultrasound examinations were independently associated with an increased risk of cesarean deliveries.
